signUp.title: Sign Up
signUp.lead: Tell us about you and your company.

rules.case: An uppercase and a lowercase letter

terms.label: I accept the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

fullName.invalid: Use letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only (2 to 80 characters).

email.invalid: Enter a valid email address, for example name@company.com.
email.tooLong: The email address is too long (254 characters maximum).

company.invalid: Enter a valid company name (2 to 100 characters).

country.invalid: Select a country from the list.

phone.invalid: Use the international format, for example +225 00 00 00 00 00.

password.tooLong: The password is too long (128 characters maximum).
password.noCase: Use both uppercase and lowercase letters.
password.containsEmail: The password must not contain your email address.
password.common: This password is too easy to guess. Choose another one.

terms.required: You must accept the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy to continue.

errors.emailTaken: An account already exists for this email address. Try signing in.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign in is not available right now. Please try again later.
errors.signUpUnavailable: Sign up is not available right now. Please try again later.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.cooldown: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
